fields.study_design: exploratory literature review with an analytical scheme (agents, inputs and processes of decentralised septic tank plus constructed wetland treatment for rural communities); scientific articles, reviews and web pages of companies and agencies; no stated databases, search terms or selection criteria
fields.population: rural communities in Brazil (about 79 million rural residents in 2022; about 60% of rural households without adequate sewage solutions)
fields.sample_size: not stated: no count of reviewed documents; cost data adapted from one source (Perondi et al. 2019) and updated to 2023 reais with the IPCA index
fields.effect_measure: narrative synthesis with a schematic of agents, inputs and processes, a cost table (Table 1) and a table of bottlenecks (Table 2); no pooled estimate
fields.effect_estimate: Reported (not appraised): the authors argue that septic tank plus constructed wetland (ST+CW) is a technically viable low-cost option for decentralised rural sewage; implementation costs in 2023 reais include 3,943.74 for the pre-moulded tank, 7,999.73 for two pumps, 2,930.82 for piping and 681.59 for machine hire, with no standard cost because of regional input prices, system size and community labour; SNIS data cover market segmentation in only 1,463 of 5,568 municipalities (26%); decentralised sewage appears only once in Law 14.026/2020 (the regulator may allow alternative and decentralised methods in rural, remote and consolidated informal areas); the paper lists bottlenecks in financing, institutional arrangements, regulation and operation and calls for public policy and regulatory support to expand decentralised treatment.
fields.section: Full text (Portuguese, 22 pages): Introduction; Materials and methods; theoretical aspects of ST+CW; Results and discussion (Tables 1-2, Figure 5); Final considerations
fields.exact_location: Materials and methods; Table 1 (costs); Table 2 (bottlenecks); legal framework paragraphs on Law 11.445/2007 and Law 14.026/2020; Rev. Bras. Geogr. Fis. 17(3):2023-2044

evidence_level: Single-source evidence: an exploratory literature review on decentralised rural wastewater treatment (septic tank plus constructed wetland) in Brazil with a cost table and a legal and institutional discussion; no primary data or stated search method; read in full text 2026-10-04.
pdf_note: Revista Brasileira de Geografia Física 17(3):2023-2044, Portuguese with English abstract, 22 pages read; tables read as converted text
notes: ELIGIBILITY FLAG: a literature review with no stated search method and no primary data; the subject is technology costs and bottlenecks of sewage treatment (E06-type content) with a legal-framework section. Candidate for the criterion-3 audit (A22).
